basic_details.job_title: CCS HAU Young Professional II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Genetics and Plant Breeding, CCS Haryana Agricultural University (CCS HAU), Hisar, has one Young Professional-II (YP-II) post on a contractual basis under scheme 3828-C(g)-PB-124-OA. The post pays ₹42000/- p.m. fixed and runs up to 31 March 2027, which the notice says is likely to be extended. The essential qualification is an M.Sc. in Genetics and Plant Breeding or a graduate degree in Agricultural Sciences. Applications on the prescribed proforma (Annexure A) must be received by 20 November 2026, and the interview is on 21 November 2026 at 3:30 pm.

how_to_apply: Candidates apply offline on the prescribed proforma (Annexure A) printed with the notice. The complete application must be received in the office of the Professor & Head, Department of Genetics and Plant Breeding, CCS Haryana Agril. University, Hisar - 125004, by 20 November 2026. No application received after that date will be entertained for any reason. The notice does not specify the mode of sending.
The Annexure A form asks for:
Full name in block letters, father's name, date of birth, age as on the interview date, sex and marital status
Permanent address with PIN code, mobile number and e-mail address
Educational qualifications from Matriculation to Ph.D., with board or university, year of passing, marks and percentage
NET status, computer knowledge, work experience and publications
A brief note on how the candidate can contribute to the present project, and a signed self-declaration
Attested passport size photograph, fixed on the form
No objection certificate from the present employer, if applicable
Certified true copies or original certificates, to be submitted to the University
NOC from the Dean PGS, for Ph.D. students, at the interview
important_instructions: The engagement is full-time. The YP-II may not do any other work or hold another appointment, with or without remuneration. Services can be ended at any time, after due opportunity, if work and conduct are not satisfactory. Services are liable to end at any time, without any reason given, if the funding agency does not release funds. The selected candidate can leave after one month's notice or by paying one month's emoluments. When the project ends, the candidate will be relieved. The university will not be responsible for adjusting the candidate elsewhere in the university. A medical fitness certificate from the CMO of the University is required at the time of joining. An agreement on non-judicial stamped paper of Rs. 15/- must be signed before joining. The candidate must report within 15 days of the appointment order. Otherwise the appointment will be treated as cancelled and may be offered to another selected candidate. The university may modify, add, delete or amend the rules with the approval of the Vice-Chancellor, CCS HAU Hisar.

content_sections.heading: About CCS HAU Young Professional-II (YP-II)
content_sections.text: CCS Haryana Agricultural University is a university at Hisar, Haryana. This YP-II post is in the Pulses Section of its Department of Genetics and Plant Breeding. The post serves scheme 3828-C(g)-PB-124-OA under Principal Investigator Dr. Pawan Kumar. The Professor & Head of the department issued the notice.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Ph.D. students must produce a NOC from the Dean PGS at the time of interview. The application form asks whether the candidate is NET qualified, about computer knowledge (certificate, diploma or degree), work experience and published or accepted research papers. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.requirement: M.Sc. in Genetics and Plant Breeding or Graduate in Agricultural Sciences
Candidate with working experience in pulse crops will be given preference
Minimum 21 years and maximum 45 years on the last date of submission of application

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Emoluments: ₹42000/- p.m. fixed. The appointment is for the specified period only. One term runs up to 31-3-2027. The maximum engagement of a YP-II is three years (1+1+1) or the duration of the post, whichever is earlier. TA/DA will be paid at the entitlement of Grade-IV employees as given in the CCS HAU TA Rules of the University. The YP-II will not be a regular employee and will not get CPF/GPF or other benefits of regular employees. Leave will be as per university guidelines/norms. The YP-II will work under the administrative control of the Project PI.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CCS HAU Young Professional-II (YP-II)
content_sections.text: Candidates apply offline on the prescribed proforma (Annexure A) printed with the notice. The complete application must be received in the office of the Professor & Head, Department of Genetics and Plant Breeding, CCS Haryana Agril. University, Hisar - 125004, by 20 November 2026. No application received after that date will be entertained for any reason. The notice does not specify the mode of sending. The Annexure A form asks for: Full name in block letters, father's name, date of birth, age as on the interview date, sex and marital status Permanent address with PIN code, mobile number and e-mail address Category (SC/ST/OBC/General) Educational qualifications from Matriculation to Ph.D., with board or university, year of passing, marks and percentage NET status, computer knowledge, work experience and publications A brief note on how the candidate can contribute to the present project, and a signed self-declaration Attested passport size photograph, fixed on the form No objection certificate from the present employer, if applicable Original certificates at the interview Certified true copies or original certificates, to be submitted to the University NOC from the Dean PGS, for Ph.D. students, at the interview

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The interview will be held on 21 November 2026 at 3:30 pm in the office of the Director of Research, CCS HAU, Hisar. No separate letter for the interview will be issued, and no TA/DA will be paid for attending it. Candidates must produce or show their original certificates at the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the CCS HAU YP-II recruitment?
faq.answer: There is one Young Professional-II (YP-II) post, in the Pulses Section of the Department of Genetics and Plant Breeding.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be received in the office of the Professor & Head, Genetics and Plant Breeding, by 20 November 2026. No application after that date will be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Sc. in Genetics and Plant Breeding or a graduate degree in Agricultural Sciences. Working experience in pulse crops will be given preference.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is minimum 21 years and maximum 45 years on the last date of submission of application, with relaxation as per university rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the YP-II post?
faq.answer: The emoluments are ₹42000/- p.m. fixed.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the Annexure A proforma, fix an attested passport size photograph, and make sure the form reaches the office of the Professor & Head, Department of Genetics and Plant Breeding, CCS Haryana Agril. University, Hisar - 125004, by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. When and where is the interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 21 November 2026 at 3:30 pm in the office of the Director of Research, CCS HAU, Hisar. No separate interview letter will be issued.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is contractual, with a term up to 31 March 2027 that is likely to be extended. The total engagement is at most three years (1+1+1) or the duration of the post, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, TA/DA will not be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What must Ph.D. students bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Ph.D. students must produce a NOC from the Dean PGS at the time of interview.
